hypothesis: The root cause is an incorrect boundary condition check in the 'bracket' method of 'UnivariateRealSolverUtils'. The condition 'fa * fb >= 0.0' incorrectly throws a 'ConvergenceException' when 'f(b)' is exactly 0.0, even though a root has been successfully found at 'b'.
prediction: Changing the condition from 'fa * fb >= 0.0' to 'fa * fb > 0.0' will allow the method to return the bracketed interval when one of the endpoints is a root.
experiment_rationale: The provided fix diff confirms that the condition 'fa * fb >= 0.0' was changed to 'fa * fb > 0.0'. This is a classic boundary condition error in a predicate.
